name: Heman
description: Singer living at the time of United Monarchy

points: These are they that waited with their children, the singers of the sons of the Kohathites: Heman the singer, and his line traced back through Levi to Israel.

note.label: 1 Chronicles 6: The Sons of Levi and the Priesthood

points: Heman, Asaph, and Ethan were appointed to sound cymbals of brass; others played harps and psalteries; the priests blew the trumpets before the ark, and doorkeepers were set. Every rank had its assigned place.

note.label: 1 Chronicles 15: None Ought to Carry the Ark but the Levites

points: Heman and Jeduthun with trumpets and instruments gave thanks because his mercy endureth forever, and all the people departed, and David returned to bless his house.

note.label: 1 Chronicles 16: The Song Delivered into the Hand of Asaph

points: David and the captains of the host separated to the service the sons of Asaph, Heman, and Jeduthun, who should prophesy with harps, psalteries, and cymbals. Music is a form of prophecy. Miriam, when she came out, prophesied with the women, leading them in prophecy which was with music.

note.label: 1 Chronicles 25: The Singers and Musicians of the Sanctuary

points: When the priests came out of the holy place, the Levite singers, Asaph, Heman, and Jeduthun with their sons and brethren, stood arrayed in white linen with cymbals, psalteries, and harps, and a hundred and twenty priests sounded with trumpets.
